recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色中低倍下，一個模糊結節區內陽性小淋巴球明顯較密集，其中散在許多由陽性細胞圍成、中心未染色的環狀結構（rosettes），與 NLPHL 中 T 細胞包圍 LP 細胞的型態相符。
features: Vague nodular zone with a higher density of positive small lymphocytes than the surrounding area
Numerous ring-shaped rosettes of positive cells surrounding larger unstained central cells
Membranous red staining of small lymphocytes, with negative small lymphocytes in the adjacent zones
Small vessels at the periphery of the nodule
Antibody identity not labeled; pattern typical of PD-1/CD57 or CD3 rosetting
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low-to-medium power shows a vaguely nodular area with an increased density of positive small lymphocytes. Many positive cells form ring-like rosettes around larger unstained central cells, while adjacent areas contain predominantly negative small lymphocytes. The rosetting pattern is characteristic of T cells (typically PD-1+ or CD57+ T follicular helper cells) encircling lymphocyte predominant cells. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation of the marker and of the B-cell phenotype of the central cells (CD20, OCT2, BOB1) is recommended.

ddx.vs: LRCHL may also show T-cell rosettes, but the central HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and lack strong CD20/OCT2/BOB1.
PTGC nodules contain small B cells and scattered germinal center cells without LP cells rimmed by PD-1+ rosettes.
THRLBCL is diffuse with a CD8+ predominant T-cell background and usually lacks PD-1+ rosettes and nodular meshworks.

ddx.dx: Nodal peripheral T-cell lymphoma with TFH phenotype
ddx.vs: TFH lymphoma shows sheets of atypical PD-1+/CD10+/BCL6+ T cells with clonal TCR, not rosettes restricted around scattered large B cells.
